[0:21 - 0:30] One step: the violins enter high on a sustained A (A5) and the B-flat a semitone above it (B-flat5), and the whole texture grows to mezzo-piano, then holds absolutely still. No further swell and no further change.
[0:30 - 0:34] The strings stop; silence.
Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. Avoid: percussion, pulses or ostinatos, tremolo, sul ponticello, clusters, piano, electric piano, glassy or shimmering sounds, deep bass, risers, impacts, stingers, glissandi, melody, crescendos to forte, trailer clichés, and melodrama.
